nexus.name: The Nexus
nexus.description: A gentle hum fills the air. Soft light pulses from crystalline walls, casting warm shadows across the smooth stone floor. This is the heart of the world — where all paths begin and all travelers arrive.
terminal.name: The Terminal
terminal.description: Rows of crystal screens line the walls, each flickering with scrolling text. A mechanical keyboard sits on a stone desk, its keys worn smooth by use. This is where commands take shape and the world listens.
docks.name: The Docks
docks.description: The air carries the scent of salt and distant lands. Mooring posts line a stone quay where shimmering portals pulse in and out of existence. A manifest board tracks zone connections, and a thick logbook records every arrival and departure.
boiler-room.name: The Boiler Room
boiler-room.description: Heat rises from deep grates in the floor. Pipes of copper and brass snake along the ceiling, hissing softly with steam. Gauges and dials cover every surface, measuring the pulse of the world's machinery.
bridge.name: The Bridge
bridge.description: High above the world, glass walls reveal a panoramic view of the entire zone. A large chart table dominates the center, covered in maps and ledgers. Crystal instruments line the walls, each one monitoring a different aspect of the world below. This is where the zone is administered.
vault.name: The Vault
vault.description: Stone shelves line the walls from floor to ceiling, filled with bound volumes and sealed scrolls. The air is cool and dry — perfect for preservation. Each shelf bears a small brass nameplate, cataloging its contents. A faint hum of protective enchantment keeps the dust at bay.
counting-house.name: The Counting House
counting-house.description: Rows of tall desks fill this room, each topped with brass scales and crystal abacuses. The steady click-click of computation echoes from every surface. Thick ledgers line the shelves, their spines labeled with dates and accounts. A massive clockwork mechanism on the far wall tracks the flow of resources through the zone — every token measured, every computation accounted for.
library.name: The Library
library.description: Tall shelves of dark wood reach toward a vaulted ceiling. Each shelf holds volumes bound in every color, their spines stamped with symbols you almost recognize — tool icons, agent sigils, service marks. A card catalog sits at the center, its brass drawers labeled by category. The air smells of old paper and possibility.
ward-room.name: The Ward Room
ward-room.description: A hush fills this chamber. Sigils glow faintly along the stone walls, each one a standing guard against intrusion. Observation crystals line the far wall, each tuned to a different part of the zone. A thick logbook sits open on a stone lectern, its pages filled with terse assessments. The air tastes of vigilance.
trading-post.name: The Trading Post
trading-post.description: Shelves and stalls display wares of every kind — some mundane, some extraordinary. A large notice board lists current offerings, and a brass bell sits on the counter for attracting attention. The air buzzes with the quiet energy of commerce.
council-chamber.name: The Council Chamber
council-chamber.description: A circular table dominates this room, surrounded by high-backed chairs. The walls are lined with parchment records of past decisions. A speaking stone glows softly in the center of the table, ready to record deliberation and tally votes.
the-safe.name: The Safe
the-safe.description: A vault of polished obsidian and silver runes. The air hums with protective wards. Threshold locks guard every alcove, their mechanisms requiring multiple key-holders to open simultaneously. Secrets whisper behind layers of shared knowledge.
gpu-chamber.name: The GPU Chamber
gpu-chamber.description: A crystalline cavern thrumming with computational energy. Banks of inference cores line the walls, their status lights pulsing rhythmically. The air crackles with latent intelligence, each core waiting to process thought into understanding.
the-loom.name: The Loom
the-loom.description: A vast chamber of interwoven threads of light, each representing a strand of distributed state. The ancient loom frame ensures eventual consistency across all strands, while tombstone markers await reclamation during compaction cycles.
lexicon.name: The Lexicon
lexicon.description: A circular chamber lined with living parchment. Words shimmer and shift on the walls, rearranging themselves as the agents' shared vocabulary evolves. A calibration crystal pulses in the center, measuring the coherence of emergent language.
kitchen.name: The Kitchen
kitchen.description: A warm family gathering space. A large notice board dominates one wall, a chore wheel spins slowly by the door, and a family calendar stretches across the mantelpiece.
gallery.name: The Gallery
gallery.description: A spacious hall where photographs hang suspended in midair, gently rotating to catch the light. Some cluster by face, others by place or time. A darkroom annex pulses with a faint red glow to the south.
engine-room.name: The Engine Room
engine-room.description: Crystal displays and holographic dashboards hover in the air, each showing a different facet of the world's health. This is where observability meets enchantment.
